subject: general
question: Which of the following states is NOT a part of the Peninsular Plateau in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Peninsular Plateau** in India is a large region of elevated land that lies to the south of the** Indo-Gangetic Plain.**
 
• It is mainly composed of **Precambrian rocks** that are millions of years old.
 
• The plateau covers parts of several Indian states, including **Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and Kerala.**
 
• However, **Punjab** is **not **a part of the Peninsular Plateau.
 
• It is located in the northwest of India and is mainly composed of **alluvial plains and river valleys.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Peninsular Plateau** is characterized by its composition of ancient** crystalline, igneous, and metamorphic** rocks.
 
• **Maharashtra** is a part of the Peninsular Plateau and includes the Deccan Plateau, which is a** large volcanic plateau** that covers much of central and southern India.
 
• **Madhya Pradesh **is also a part of the Peninsular Plateau and includes the **Vindhya and Satpura **mountain ranges, as well as parts of the Deccan Plateau.
 
• **Tamil Nadu** is a state in the south of India that is also a part of the Peninsular Plateau.
 
• It includes the **Eastern Ghats mountain range** and the **Nilgiri Hills.**
